brand_as_institution.value: Strengthen More as a brand/institution, not as the story of one designer; people behind it may appear but are not the narrative.

sources.ref: call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
sources.quote: A gente quer muito mais fortalecer a marca como marca, como instituição

not_tied_to_atelier.value: Do not tie the More origin story to the atelier.

sources.ref: call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
sources.quote: O que a gente não quer fazer é atrelar

register.value: Few words, declarative, material-first ('Estofada, com estrutura de madeira maciça.'). No adjectives of luxury, no exclamation.

language_gap.value: UI is Portuguese but the about and menu statements are in English placeholder text ('More is a design studio and gallery...'), repeated twice.
language_gap.notes: Decide PT, EN or bilingual before launch.

ui_words.value: Assentos, Estantes, Luminárias, Mesas, Fixos; Selecione a Madeira / o Tecido; A partir de; Adicionar; Detalhes; Descrição; Baixar; Outros Produtos.

products.value: Pieces carry first names or Brazilian art references (Poltrona Leticia, Banco João, Mesa Cildo, Sofá Catedral, Mesa Carnívora, Tomada TOM.01).

wordmark.value: Custom geometric wordmark 'MORE': heavy blocky letters, the O a thick ring, the R cut as a quarter-round. Official file: assets/official/more-wordmark.svg (from the site's inline SVG). Colour: preto on light, branco/cinza-claro on dark.

intro_animation.value: Home opens with the wordmark built letter by letter in greys to black, the line 'Menos do mesmo.' centred, then dissolves into the catalogue.

usage.value: Never redraw, stretch, outline or recolour the wordmark outside preto / branco / cinza-claro; never generate it with an image model: composite the SVG.

palette.value: Warm, quiet, paper-like: off-white #E5E1DB ground, preto #2D211E (brown-black, never pure black) for ink, cinza-escuro #5D554F for the inverse block and footer, cinza-medio #686868 for metadata, one cool accent ciano-destaque #8BC0D0. See brand/tokens/color.tokens.json.

accent_rule.value: Ciano-destaque is the only chromatic UI colour; on the live site it marks the 'Fixos' category, where the buyable tomada lives. Keep it for 'available now'.

colour_comes_from_pieces.value: Saturated colour on the site comes from the pieces and materials (ipê, sucupira, bouclê, veludo jambo, vidro fundido), never from UI chrome.

woods.value: Madeira options: Ipê, Sucupira, Tauari, Angelim Pedra, each natural / tonalizada / ebanizada.

fabrics.value: Tecido options: Bouclê Neve, Marfim, Areia, Flocos, Bronze, Ouro Velho, Cereja; Tecido Palha, Tecido Outono; Veludo Caramelo, Veludo Jambo, Veludo Girassol.
fabrics.notes: Shopify data has typos to fix: 'Velugo Girassol', 'Angelim Pedra ebanidada'.

lacquer_glass_metal.value: Vidro / metal pintado: Branco Glacial, Amarelo Igaratá, Verde Jamaica, Vermelho Jambo, Marrom Ginger, Azul Marselha, Preto Bali. Vidro fundido: Guaraná, Âmbar, Berinjela, Azul Índigo. Metal natural: Alumínio Semi Polido, Bronze Natural, Bronze Envelhecido.

naming_logic.value: Colour names are Brazilian places, fruits and drinks (Igaratá, Jambo, Guaraná, Jamaica, Bali): use this register when naming new finishes.

families.value: Two 205TF families, self-hosted: Muoto (Regular) for product names, prices, statements and filters; Muoto Mono Condensed for the interface voice (menu, buttons, labels, footer). The theme's default body font is the mono.

licence.value: 205TF faces are commercial: confirm the web licence covers new pages and any generated material before reuse.

scale.value: Small, flat scale: 10 caption, 11 label, 13 body/UI, 15 filter, 22 product title, 26 statement, 32 about. One weight (400); 600 only for the active filter. No uppercase, no letter-spacing tricks.

catalog.value: Grid view: 4 columns, 7vw gaps, 3:4 portrait images; mobile 2 columns with every 5th card full-width. List view: 10-column grid per product with 6px gaps, portrait 2 cols, landscape 3:2 3 cols, 160px between products.

pdp.value: PDP: three zones on desktop: info + selectors left, one tall 3:4 image centre, numbered thumbnails 01-04 right. Mobile: image first, swatches, title, accordions.

scale.value: Tight base 6 / 10 / 16 / 20 / 30 px; air comes from big gaps (7vw, 160px) not from padding. Page gutter 20px desktop, 10px mobile.

look_and_feel.value: Feels like a luxury paper catalog/magazine, not glassy digital UI. Square/straight corners, editorial grid.

sources.ref: call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
sources.quote: o site parece Um papel. Isso é legal, parece um negócio luxuoso de papel

look_and_feel.notes: JJ reading during the call; tokens pending site capture (blocked by network).

floating_bars.value: All navigation lives in floating 35px bars centred at the bottom (logo + Menu [+]), the CTA bar above it, the filter bar at the top: glass (preto 10% + blur), square corners, they grow to 580px when opened.

bracket_buttons.value: Text buttons in mono with square brackets: [Voltar], [Lista], [Sobre nós], Menu [+].

cta_bar.value: Primary action is a bar, not a button: preto-80 background, mono label left ('A partir de' / 'Adicionar'), price right in Muoto.

swatches.value: Material swatches are square photo crops of the real material (wood blocks, fabric), 6 visible + '+N'; colour dots only for the tomada core.

accordions.value: Detalhes / Descrição / Baixar as hairline-ruled accordions under the title.

product_card.value: Name left, price right in cinza-medio under a 3:4 image; hover swaps to a smaller centred second image (scale .8 to 1).

whatsapp_handoff.value: Made-to-order CTA 'A partir de R$' opens WhatsApp with a pre-filled message: product + selected materials (e.g. 'Poltrona Leticia | Materiais: Ipê ebanizada, Bouclê Flocos'). The CTA label does not say WhatsApp.

buy_flow.value: Only the tomada (tag 'Comprar') has Adicionar > cart drawer > Shopify checkout (Pagar.me).

character.value: Slow, soft and short: fades and grows of 0.2-0.8s, ease-out curves (.22,1,.36,1); hover swaps on a snappy (.63,.01,0,1.01). Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

studio_catalog.value: Studio product photography, multiple angles side by side in a grid; editorial, paper-like, magazine feel.

sources.ref: call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
sources.quote: As fotos foram feitas em estúdio

ambient_selective.value: Ambient/in-project photos only when the project is aesthetically aligned; Instagram is the looser channel for them.

sources.ref: call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
sources.quote: se o projeto não for muito bonito, não for esteticamente alinhado

no_ai_alteration_of_pieces.value: AI must never alter the piece itself; finish-swap imagery is phase 2/3 and must be exact.

sources.ref: call transcript JJ x More team, 2026-10-15 (Joao upload message.md)
sources.quote: IA é complicado porque não pode mudar nada da peça

studio_light.value: Studio: warm beige seamless, one hard sun-like key from the side throwing a crisp window shadow on floor and wall, piece at 3/4, camera slightly above seat height.
